notes: Fair Workweek Ordinance (Emeryville Mun. Code Title 5 ch. 39), effective July 1, 2017, covers retail firms with 56+ employees globally.

Predictability pay: 1 hour for changes with <14 days but >=24 h notice; for <24 h notice, 4 hours or the scheduled shift length, whichever is less (extra key change_premium_hours_under_24h=4); other <24 h changes 1 hour.
Employers must first offer extra hours to existing qualified part-timers up to 35 h/week.
Right to rest: 1.5x for hours worked between shifts separated by less than 11 hours; employee may decline.

rules.summary: Retail firms with 56+ employees globally must post schedules two weeks ahead and pay predictability pay for later changes.
